summary: Read-dispatch wrapper on a stream-like object. When the state flag at offset 0x10 is nonzero, reads a2 bytes directly through AudioStreamBufferRead on the stream handle at offset 0x0. Otherwise it reads through sub_587F64; a nonzero return there signals failure and yields -1, otherwise a2 (the requested read size) is returned.

local_names.this: stream wrapper object; [0] (offset 0x0) is the underlying stream handle passed to both read paths, [4] (offset 0x10) is the state flag selecting the path
local_names.a2: read request size/count forwarded to both read paths

operations.description: Branch on the state flag this[4] (offset 0x10): a nonzero value selects the audio stream buffer read path.
Read through AudioStreamBufferRead(*this, a2, 0) using the stream handle stored at offset 0x0.
Return the result of AudioStreamBufferRead directly.
When the flag is clear, read through sub_587F64(*this, a2, 0) on the same stream handle.
A nonzero return from sub_587F64 indicates read failure.
Return -1 when the sub_587F64 read path reports failure.
Return a2, the requested read size, when the sub_587F64 read path succeeds.
